facts.1. First contracted caravan is scheduled: 30; due key 28971000. Gate staff can begin routine inspection under standing orders, but exceptional cargo, identity, custody, contract, or security questions require lawful authority.
facts.2. Sword Manor Commander Wei Jian reques: 00 command council concerning current escort obligations and training allocation; due key 28972800. Tang Wei has not promised attendance or delegated his position.
facts.adjacent_security: Duan Jin and Shen Rui wait in the family-hall antechamber; they are not scene participants unless called or a threat develops
facts.current_decision: Tang Wei chooses his first priority of the morning or declares another free-form action
facts.forbidden_inference: no dialogue, thought, emotion, priority, order, travel, oath, payment, appointment, promise, report opening, or combat action has been chosen for Tang Wei
facts.immediate_pressure: a potentially urgent Kanyou intelligence report exists now, a caravan inspection begins at 07:30, and the Sword Manor council begins at 08:00
facts.participants: Tang Wei, Tang Zhu, Tang Ling, Tang Kai
physical_setting: cold winter dawn; the sky beyond the wooden lattice is beginning to grey
two low braziers warm the inner hall; oil lamps still burn near the family table
lacquered breakfast trays have been set but the meal has not begun
Tang Kai holds a small carved wooden horse and remains close to Tang Wei
Tang Ling has a cord-bound bamboo-slip case on the table; its inner clay seal remains intact
no alarm bell, mobilization order, or public disturbance is audible inside the manor
facts.scene_mood: intimate family warmth held under controlled political pressure
facts.what_waiting_changes: delaying may preserve the birthday morning, but it reduces time to investigate the report or prepare for the two scheduled obligations
npc_current_postures: Tang Zhu deliberately leaves the first priority to Tang Wei and watches how he weighs family, security, commerce, and institutional duty
Tang Ling believes the political report may deserve attention before routine commitments narrow House Tang's options
Tang Kai wants Tang Wei's attention and does not understand the political stakes
Duan Jin and Shen Rui remain ready outside without intruding
Wei Jian is at the Sword Manor command hall preparing the 08:00 council
